summary: Market mood is mixed: gold is bullish as oil falls on hopes of Middle East diplomatic progress, while Brent crude is under pressure.[1] Crypto evidence is limited and mostly reflects selected altcoin strength and accumulation interest, with event and token-unlock risks keeping conviction moderate.[2][3][5]
